name: Pet chews (including dental chews)
analog_label: the plant-carbohydrate fraction of a complete diet — cereals, grains, pulses, and starchy tubers (adult/general human food, as sold)
feed_law_note: Pet food is legally governed by feed law — EU Directive 2002/32/EC on undesirable substances in animal feed, FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine guidance, and AAFCO model regulations — whose maximum levels are generally laxer than the corresponding human-food limits. Japan (FAMIC pet-food standard) and China (draft pet-food guidance) set enforced or proposed pet-food maxima in the same lax range. The HMTc standard for each analyte is not the feed limit: it is the strictest applicable human-food sovereign maximum for the nearest human-food analog, adopted as a voluntary human-grade over-compliance. The feed floor is disclosed on every row and never selects the number.

feed_floor.scope: compound feed for dogs, cats, ornamental fish and fur animals

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). No in-force sovereign sets a separate MeHg maximum level for this product on its basis, so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total mercury ceiling (20 ug/kg); no separate MeHg ceiling is published. MeHg is speciated whenever tHg exceeds its reflex trigger.
